title: Restoring the HECM Line After a Cured Maturity Case
content:
When a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan returns to active status after a cured maturity case, Cedarline books the reinstatement restoration, the amount credited back to the available line for the prepaid portions applied while the loan was due and payable.

**Prepaid portions that restored nothing.** On the fixed-rate single disbursement plan, and on any loan that is due and payable or in the deferral period, a prepaid portion posts as restoring nothing to the line and nothing is restored at the time. Once a loan other than a fixed-rate single disbursement returns to active status after a cured maturity case, and only then, the portions it posted as restoring nothing to the line are credited back through the reinstatement restoration.

| Loan when the portion was applied | Restored at the time | Restored later |
|---|---|---|
| active, on a plan that credits prepaid amounts back to the line | yes, the same day | — |
| due and payable or in the deferral period, other than a fixed-rate single disbursement | no | through the reinstatement restoration, once the loan returns to active after a cured maturity case |
| fixed-rate single disbursement | no | no |

## Booking the restoration: `restore_reinstated_line_c85e4df8`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `restore_reinstated_line_c85e4df8` and calls it. One call books, dated today, one line restoration entry for the stated amount referencing a prepaid portion that was applied while the loan was due and payable, and raises the loan's available line by the same amount; the loan balance does not change. Afterwards the borrower sees the higher available line and the restoration entry on the loan history.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `hecm_loan_id` | Reference number of the reinstated HECM loan, as returned by the HECM loan lookup. |
| `source_txn_ref` | Reference number of the prepaid portion (a prepayment entry posted while the loan was due and payable) being restored, as returned by the HECM transaction lookup for the loan. |
| `restore_amount` | The amount credited back to the available line, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places; stored as given, rounded half up to the cent. |

**Return.** A sentence beginning "Line restoration booked" gives the restoration entry reference (beginning "hrs_"), the prepaid portion it references, the amount restored with 2 decimals, the effective date (today) and the loan's new available line; it means the entry is on the loan.
